en: Dependent on a state whose root is to be abandoned by vision, there arises a state that is not a root and does not have a root to be abandoned by vision, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Dependent on a state whose root is to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state that is not a root and does not have a root to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of root condition. ... Under root condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Dependent on a state whose root is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, there arises a state that is not a root and whose root is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, by way of the root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). Under the root-condition, there is one [formula]... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*), there are three.
